settings.eyebrow: Desk mats, made for long hours
settings.heading: Your desk, finally finished.
settings.body: One surface that quiets the keys, glides under the mouse and gives the whole desk a single, deliberate edge.

settings.heading: The Desk Mat
settings.body: A desk mat is the one upgrade you feel every hour. It gives the keyboard a softer floor, the mouse an even surface, and the desk a defined working area instead of scattered gear.
settings.point_1: Full-desk coverage for keyboard and mouse
settings.point_2: Even, consistent tracking from edge to edge
settings.point_4: Lies flat and stays where you put it

settings.title: A quieter desk
settings.body: The mat takes the hard edge off key chatter and mouse clicks — the difference shows up on long calls and late sessions.

settings.title: Edge-to-edge tracking
settings.body: An even surface means the cursor behaves the same at the far corner as it does in the middle. No dead patches, no hunting.

settings.title: One defined surface
settings.body: Keyboard, mouse, phone, notebook. Everything lands inside one boundary instead of drifting across the desk.

settings.title: Kinder to the desk
settings.body: A layer between hardware and the desktop keeps scuffs, scratches and coffee rings off the surface underneath.

settings.title: Wipes clean
settings.body: Dust, crumbs and the occasional spill come off with a damp cloth. No special treatment required.

settings.title: Looks considered
settings.body: The fastest way to make a desk look finished rather than assembled — one rectangle pulling the setup together.

settings.heading: Built for the hours you actually spend here.
settings.body: Work days run long. The mat is there for the whole of it — under the keyboard at nine, under the notebook at two, wiped down at six and ready again tomorrow.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched from Lahore. Exact delivery times are set in the store's shipping policy and shown at checkout.

settings.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
settings.answer: Payment methods available to you are shown at checkout once payment providers are activated on the store.

settings.question: What if it is not right for my desk?
settings.answer: Returns follow the store's refund policy. Contact us with your order number and we will take it from there.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: A damp cloth handles everyday dust and marks. Let it dry flat before putting hardware back on it.

settings.question: Will it stay flat?
settings.answer: Store it flat rather than rolled. If it has been rolled in transit, leave it on the desk overnight and it settles.

settings.heading: Finish the desk.
settings.body: One mat, one surface, one less thing to think about.

settings.heading: Looks right in any setup.
settings.body: Warm wood, white minimal or dark battlestation — the mat is the piece that ties the surface together.
